title: A note on irreducible representations of symmetric groups and Sergeev superalgebras
summary: We provide an explicit construction and a closed dimension formula in terms of hook lengths for the irreducible representations for the symmetric groups $\mathfrak{S}_p$ and the Sergeev superalgebras $\mathcal{Y}_p$ over an algebraically closed field $\mathbb{F}$ of characteristic $p>0$.
